ambiguities.text: No specification of maximum symbol length or allowed character set
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume symbol should follow typical conventions: 2-5 uppercase ASCII characters. Applications should sanitize display to prevent injection attacks.

ambiguities.text: No guidance on how nodes should determine their symbol for chains without a standard registry
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume node operators configure the symbol manually based on chain identity. For mainnet, 'ETH' is the de facto standard.

ambiguities.text: No specification of error response format if the node does not support this method
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard JSON-RPC error with method not found code (-32601) if not supported.

implicit_assumptions.description: Users implicitly trust the RPC node to provide accurate network identification
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users could be tricked into signing transactions on the wrong network, leading to loss of funds or unintended actions

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker controlling an RPC endpoint can return any symbol string they choose
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: This assumption is true by design - the security consideration acknowledges this vulnerability. Mitigation requires additional verification mechanisms.

implicit_assumptions.description: Wallets will cross-reference symbol with chain ID and other identifiers for security-critical operations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If wallets rely solely on eth_symbol for network identification, users face increased phishing risk from malicious RPC endpoints

implicit_assumptions.description: This is a read-only informational endpoint with no consensus implications
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: N/A - this assumption holds as the method has no on-chain effects
